text: このあたりは　もう　キノコ　みつかんないかも　だって　あたしが　ぜんぶ　とっちゃったもん

structure.jp: もう　キノコ　みつかんないかも
structure.en: you might not find mushrooms any more

structure.jp: あたしが　ぜんぶ　とっちゃったもん
structure.en: I took them all, that's why

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.explanation: かも is short for かもしれない, 'maybe'. みつかんない is a slurred みつからない. みつかんないかも = 'they might not be found'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the casual short form of てしまった, which says something was done completely. とっちゃった = 'I went and took them all'.

patterns.name: 〜もの
patterns.explanation: もん is the casual form of もの at the end of a sentence, giving a reason in a childish, slightly pouty tone. とっちゃったもん = 'because I took them, that's why'.
